title: 清蓝岸边的一天
goal: 在冷色主调中自主保留阳光感
scene: A pale blue lake viewed from a small stony shore, one broad light beige rock platform enters from bottom left, dark ochre narrow side plane, muted-teal reed clump at right, pale blue-gray far bank. Cyan and blue-green limited horizontal water strokes, generous white sparkling reserved gaps, no boat, bridge, people or mountains. Cool palette but sunny. Moderate simple brushstroke illustration with broad color masses.
decision: 先选岸线走向和光向；白色水光须在铺色前设计
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square standalone original S002 sunlit brushstroke landscape artwork on white marker paper. Transparent oil/alcohol student-marker aesthetic, broad readable color masses and selective natural short plant strokes, sunny light and shadow groups, airy white paper, NO thick black outlines, NO cute faces. No printed words, numbers, panels, color swatches, watermarks or tools. Use only stated approximate hue families, slight same-marker overlap allowed; no smooth digital gradients, opaque impasto or pale strokes painted over dark. Reserve white shapes BEFORE color. No unnecessary microdetail or dense all-over texture. Narrow natural white margins. Composition must be distinct from other scenes. Intended for 16.5cm square marker paper. Stage: D4 independent project exemplar, composition and decisions matter, not necessarily more details than D3. Moderate simple brushstroke illustration with broad color masses. Palette: 67 pale cyan; 65 blue-green; 63 bright cyan blue; 143 extremely pale blue-gray; 58 muted teal; 25 very pale gray-beige; 95 ochre brown. Keep relative hue character, these are planning labels not calibrated exact colors.
review_note: 自主或专项示意；阶段为目标规划，实际能力需通过练习反馈复盘。

color_review.method: 工具档案相对色系、区域分工、成品与关键图文字交叉核对；非精确色度与实笔验证
